note: Hand-labelled paragraph relations for scripts/verify-relate.ts: per paragraph, 1 when it states that the statement is true (supports), false (refutes) or is about its topic (relates), 0.5 for partial cases. `first` chose the method (2026-11-08); `second` was written afterwards to check it. `nuance` relates the same paragraphs to an absolute and a qualified statement: a paragraph that only contradicts the absolute one must refute it more. A smoke set, not a benchmark.
